description: Selling the same seat more than once because two requests both saw it as free.
A test that releases many threads together with a latch so their operations really overlap.
A database rule that rejects a duplicate seat label for an event, as a last line of defense.
A transaction that locks, checks, changes and returns without remote calls while holding the lock.
A response header or value that shows whether the data came from the cache, easier to assert than timing.
An integration test that starts real PostgreSQL and Redis containers instead of mocks.
